Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for assay CHEMBL1794523. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, and to compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1794523, exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
